title: Export a complete workspace offline
description: Generate and download a complete WorkspaceBundle entirely in the browser while reporting included counts, schema versions, progress, and integrity outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Export works with network access disabled and never uploads workspace data
The downloaded bundle includes every registered current record, named snapshot, and referenced asset
A pre-download summary reports per-type counts, versions, asset bytes/counts, and integrity success
Dangling references or integrity failures block download with actionable errors
Progress and completion are announced and cancellation/failure leaves durable state unchanged

steps.details: Read every registered repository and asset in a consistent export snapshot, then canonicalize records without mutating IndexedDB.
Construct the versioned manifest, calculate integrity metadata over canonical records/assets, and reject unresolved references before download.
Add a labeled keyboard-operable export action with progress/status announcements, inspectable summary, safe filename, and local Blob download.
Cover complete/empty workspaces, assets, integrity block, cancellation/failure, offline mode, summary counts, and no network requests.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; connect the existing registry to one focused offline export path.
A downloaded backup remains user-owned and outside application storage control.
Use bounded/chunked work where existing APIs permit; numeric limits await profiling.
